utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the carpool leave, and who’s driving?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It leaves at 7:30, and I’m pretty sure Sam’s driving.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks—should I be ready at 7:20?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can pitch in with the carpool. What time do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—thanks, Gus. I think we need to leave around 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll be ready by 7:30 and can bring the keys if needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool is still on for tomorrow, but there may be one extra stop. I’ll check and let you know if the route changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — I’d appreciate the heads-up since an extra stop could change the timing a bit.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll confirm the route and text you if anything shifts. Hopefully it stays pretty smooth tomorrow!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the carpool. What days and times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — I’m thinking weekday mornings around 7:30, and maybe afternoons around 3:30 if needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That works for me — I can do weekday mornings around 7:30, and I may be able to help some afternoons at 3:30 too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Uli, I’m putting together the carpool plan—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn — yes, please save me a spot. I may be a little late, but I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ve got you on the list. No worries if you’re a bit late—just text me when you’re on your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m putting the carpool together and making sure everyone’s timing lines up. Want me to confirm your pickup time?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes please — 8:15 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll mark you down for 8:15 and keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I say yes, can you remind me who’s driving and what time pickup is?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m not sure yet—I'm usually the late joiner. Let me check and get back to you with the driver and pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, thanks — just let me know once you’ve checked the driver and pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—what time do you need the carpool to pick up and drop off? I can coordinate around school if you send me the details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — pickup around 7:30 and drop-off by 8:15 would be great if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, that works for me—I can do 7:30 pickup and 8:15 drop-off. I’ll make it fit around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the carpool might start next week—did you hear any final details?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I haven’t heard the final details yet, but I’m happy to check in and let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Jules — I’d really appreciate that. I’m relying on second-hand updates here, so just let me know whenever you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the pickup time and I’ll do my best to be there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what pickup time works for you?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Morning works best for me — around 8:00 if that’s okay.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren — I’m still flexible for the carpool, so just let me know what time works best.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — thanks, Rey. I’ll check the time and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — thanks, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll repeat the carpool plan to everyone and make sure we’re all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll let everyone know the plan and check back if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Rey — any update on the carpool schedule? I’m out running errands, so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Ira — I don’t have the schedule confirmed yet, but I’m checking and will let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — thanks, Rey. I’ll keep my phone close and plan my errands around it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the carpool — I’m happy to help, though I might need the details again. What time were we thinking?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I think we were aiming for around 7:30 tomorrow morning, and I’ll double-check the pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, 7:30 sounds good to me — just let me know the pickup details when you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, carpool — right. What time are we doing that again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 7:30 works for me. I’ll be outside a few minutes early.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: 7:30 sounds good — I’ll try to be out there a bit early too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Eli — I can lend a hand with the carpool if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s kind of you, Gus. Let’s keep it simple — I can do Mondays and Wednesdays, and we’ll stick to the same pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll take the other days and keep the same pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What days and times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh great, Mara — thank you! I was thinking weekdays around 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m., if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That could work for me — I can do weekdays around 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. as long as we keep it flexible.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I can help coordinate the carpool if you want, just let me know who’s riding and what time works.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’ll check who’s riding and what time fits, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — just send me the list and time when you have it, and I’ll help keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll organize the carpool and make sure everyone’s covered. Just send me the pickup times and I’ll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll send the pickup times over now so you can get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — send them whenever you’re ready, and I’ll map it all out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks for the update — I’m still catching up on the carpool details. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We’re still set for the usual pickup time, but I’m waiting on one confirm before it’s final. Want me to text you as soon as it’s locked in?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—that would be really helpful. I’m still a little behind, so a text when it’s locked in would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me the pickup time and address, and I’ll do my best to be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send the pickup time and our address shortly.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll keep an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What time do you want me to be ready?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what time works for you? I just want to make sure we’re on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can be ready at 7:15 if that works for you. Just let me know if you want me a few minutes earlier.
